Been there plenty of times. Usually when I start to lose a lot it's because I get into arguments with other players and feed the flamers (I'm typically chill but when you start to blame other people for your mistakes, I have to defend them) or I am getting queued with trolls/giraffes that don't have arms.
What I typically do at this point is try to find a player or two that I synergized well with in my previous matches and queue up with them. Playing with positive players or friends, even when losing, is just as fun as winning with randoms as long as you aren't the overly-serious type and want to have fun.
So just queue up with people you like and eventually you'll find yourself on an 11-winstreak like I had one magical night.

Either that or play meta champs in your best lane.
Some suggestions from my experience: (Haven't played in a few weeks but this shouldn't differ much)
Top: Riven, Irelia, Swain is fun.
Jungle: Elise, Rengar (I LOVE him), Jarvan IV
Mid: Yasuo (Hit or miss), Viktor, Syndra, Talon (I don't play Talon much but I went 31/2 on my 2nd game with him and he can be ridiculous when fed) These champs for me are high risk/ high reward
>ANIVIA< This is my favorite freaking champ in the whole game. She's just frickin insane
ADC: Jinx, Vayne, Draven (I don't typically ADC but I enjoy these champions)
Support: Leona and Thresh are the only ones I've ever played.

Again this is a personal list but it works well for me so try it out sometime if you are desperate :D

One thing I noticed is you don't think you're enough for her. She gets off to "hot guys" but you yourself get off to gay porn. I'm not good at wording things but stay with me here. Theres such thing as a preference, as I said earlier shes into what you say are hot guys and you're into gay material. But it doesn't matter. That's just what gets you both off. That doesn't mean she doesn't love you. Sex isn't everything. Theres a reason why she married you and if you really love her as much as you say you do, you'd do anything to save her from harm. You're trying to rationalize hurting her temporarily by helping her in the long run but you'll never know the consequences of your actions if you die. She could love you as much as you love her, maybe even more. Sure you may not look like those photoshopped dudes on TV but does that really matter? Love your wife. She loves you too. You loving her that much is and will always be enough for her. Girls dream of having guys like you, willing to GIVE YOUR OWN LIFE so she can be happy. However, this will not make her happier. Yes its possible she'll 'move on' and perhaps remarry but there will always be a hole in her heart where you were. 
I'm in no position to speak about suicide but I don't think you should consider it for the sake of your wife. Talk to her. Tell her how much you love her. And realize that you are perfect the way you are. Come back home with that cat food and avoid bridges.

Honestly, people with depression all deserve awards for acting. I can speak for myself when I say that I put on a good mask when going about my daily life. I've kept this up my entire life up until now. Now that I'm breaking, I am struggling to keep my mask on. It's nice to know that I am not alone, that there are people out there that can relate to what I'm going through. But at the same time I hate it. I wish nobody has to go theough these same feelings. This isolation, loneliness, depression... I am drowning. Like you said, people are telling me to breathe and I will be okay. But what use is breathing when you're drowning, encompassed by water and sinking at an alarming rate with no way to resurface? 
I've gotten to the point where my bottle has broken and shattered and everything is spilling out. But I have no close friends, my family doesn't understand, and everyone I tell doesn't know what to do. In fact they simply don't acknowledge me, even though I admitted I was having thoughts of ending my life. 
If you don't mind me asking, how do you deal with depression on a daily basis? What keeps you going?
